remarks: Outstanding investment or owner-occupant opportunity in a premier Amherst location! This spacious 5-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom split-level home offers 2,025 square feet of highly functional living space, positioned just minutes from the University at Buffalo North Campus. The 3 levels offer the opportunity to remain the investment property. or to turn back to a singer family home.   The property features energy-efficient windows, a high-efficiency furnace, central AC, and a newer complete tear-off roof with 50-year shingles. Step outside to a deep, fully fenced backyard. With its unbeatable proximity to the university, immediate access to the I-290, and surrounding shopping districts, this property boasts exceptional rental demand potential.
